{{Top|leg}}
Following the [[raid on the New Jedi Temple]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Color/Legends|silvery]] '''straptape''' was stuck across the [[New Jedi Temple|Temple Main Hall's]] [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] doors that were out of commission in wide x-patterns.<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Straptape was introduced in [[2010]]'s ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' novel series.<ref name="Backlash" />
